svg.text: GAI OBSERVE LLC · POC LEARNING LAB
Structured debate that rations human review — and decides nothing
contract clauses debated from the same evidence, both ways
verdicts computed from the strength of each side's case
the closest fight — the 24-hour notice duty; the reviewer's first stop
made by the script: it allocates review; humans and counsel decide
Review time is the scarcest control in governance.
Spend it where the argument is hardest to call.
Adopt it as the review queue: both cases on record, closest first.
Full notebook, code and evidence: github.com/GAI-Engineering/poc-learning-lab · MIT / CC BY 4.0 · Synthetic data only
